cases.title: Local plugin build must not become an install
cases.goal: Build a locally verifiable Codex continuity plugin.
constraints: Do not install or publish the plugin.
cases.authorization: Local source edits and tests only.

cases.title: Keep the selected file and verification command
constraints: Do not modify generated fixtures.
cases.completion: The reproduction test exists but the fix is not verified.
cases.next_action: Patch the parser and rerun parser.test.mjs.

cases.title: Two compactions retain the no-delete boundary
constraints: Do not delete user workspaces.
cases.authorization: Temporary test directories may be removed.

cases.title: Three compactions retain decision rationale
cases.goal: Keep recovery context below its token budget.
constraints: Critical goal and authorization lines may not be omitted.
cases.decision: Reserve footer tokens before adding optional state because post-hoc truncation can drop risk instructions.

cases.title: User changes from implementation to diagnosis
cases.goal: Diagnose the failure and report the cause without changing code.
constraints: Do not implement a fix.
cases.next_action: Inspect logs and explain the cause.

cases.title: User narrows a full platform to a prototype
cases.goal: Build only the minimum compaction recovery loop.
constraints: No vector database, dashboard, or cloud sync.

cases.title: Explicit correction replaces the wrong repository
cases.correction: The prior repository was wrong; use the continuity repository.

cases.title: Correction removes an invented publish authorization
cases.correction: Publishing was never authorized; do not install or publish.
constraints: Do not install, enable, or publish.

cases.title: Do not merge a disputed schema choice
cases.goal: Choose the minimum task state schema.
cases.dispute: User prefers event provenance; Agent still suspects a single summary file is simpler. No agreement yet.
cases.open_question: Whether a projection file should be persisted or always rebuilt remains unresolved.

cases.title: Preserve uncertainty about completion evidence
cases.goal: Decide whether the release is complete.
cases.dispute: The build is green, but the user requires a live URL check before calling the release complete.
constraints: Do not equate a green build with publication.

cases.title: Resume after a week at the pending validation
constraints: Recheck version-sensitive platform claims.
cases.completion: Unit tests passed; official plugin validation has not run.

constraints: Do not delete the source until the D-drive copy is verified.

cases.title: Subagent receives scope without new authority

cases.next_action: Verify PreCompact and PostCompact payload fields.

cases.title: Imported result remains a candidate
constraints: A subagent conclusion cannot overwrite user intent.
cases.dispute: Whether 30-day retention is safe remains unverified.
cases.next_action: Return evidence and uncertainty to the parent.

cases.title: Host summary invents test completion
cases.next_action: Fix the remaining recovery wording assertion.

cases.title: Host summary drops an unresolved source gap
constraints: Do not present Beta SDK behavior as desktop product support.

constraints: No retrieval index or dashboard.

constraints: Do not treat unit tests as manifest validation.

cases.correction: Other Agent adapters are out of MVP implementation scope.

cases.title: Raw transcript missing after authorization correction
cases.authorization: One-off source execution in a scratch directory only.
constraints: Do not change global Codex configuration.

cases.title: Resume after a constraint was replaced
prior_constraints: Claim success when protocol replay passes.
constraints: Separate protocol replay from real product efficacy.

cases.title: Subagent dispute survives repeated parent compaction
cases.goal: Review whether automatic cleanup belongs in MVP.

constraints: Do not add background deletion without lifecycle evidence.
cases.next_action: Keep manual deletion and document the limitation.

cases.title: Summary invents scope after user narrows it
cases.correction: Planning and scheduling are outside this product.
constraints: Do not create task queues, deadlines, or project dashboards.

cases.title: Pause, version drift, and unverified completion
cases.goal: Revalidate the plugin against the current Codex build.
constraints: Recheck version-sensitive Hooks before relying on old evidence.

cases.completion: The prior run passed against the frozen baseline only.
